strategies.name: SUPER_MOMENTUM_RUNNER
strategies.description: Exploits the empirically verified finding that stocks up >= +25% over 10-20 days reach an additional +5% to +10% 72.6% to 74.3% of the time. Rides leaders with +2% BE lock, +5% stepped lock, and +10% trailing ratchet.

strategies.name: CAPITULATION_PANIC_BOUNCE
strategies.description: Systematically buys liquid stocks suffering sudden -5% to -15% 1d/3d panic flushes. Backtest proves a 61.2% win rate and 7.63 Profit Factor with stepped bounce ratchets.

strategies.name: INTRADAY_MICRO_BURST_RATCHET
strategies.description: Scans rapid 5-minute price spikes (>= +1.5%) on heavy volume. Empirically demonstrated 59.2% win rate and 10.74 Profit Factor on 1-min data with tight +0.6% / +1.2% profit ratchets.

strategies.name: PARABOLIC_BLOWOFF_FADE
strategies.description: Shorts extreme parabolic overextensions (multi-day surges >= +15% to +30% or 60m surges >= +4% stretched far above VWAP and upper bands). Backtested 60.8% win rate and 7.40 Profit Factor.
